summary: Created today from the same city page; re-read and nothing has changed (six full-hookup sites, no rate, season or amperage posted). Groups current: flags only.
flags: NO CHANGE: the city page still says 'Veterans' Park Campground. Nestled along the Lac qui Parle River on the southwest part of town, this quaint campground has room for six campers. This is a full hook-up with electricity, water and sewer. Enjoy the benches and watch the river go by. Built next to the disc golf course, river dock and playground, bring your lawn chairs and enjoy!' No rate, season, amperage or dump stated.

BOOKING (not written): the page's reservation sentence ('Reservations are encouraged, please call ahead for availability ...') sits in the Gnome Park paragraph, and the card-payment line names 'The Dawson Campground'; both may cover Veterans' Park too (same city office, 320-769-2154), but the page does not say so.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept, but a possible riverview for the reviewer: on Esri z19 imagery a dirt pull-off lane with posts (likely the hookup pedestals) runs along the north side of the street at the south edge of the open riverside lawn, about 44.92632,-96.05600 .. -96.05560. From its east end the river bank (about 44.92670,-96.05530) is roughly 45-55 m across open grass partly behind a tree clump; the west end is ~75 m. The page invites campers to 'watch the river go by'. The site positions are not confirmed (no site map or photo), so the default-down value stands.
PIN 44.92593,-96.05649 is on the street ~60 m SW of the probable site lane (well under 250 m); confirmed. Phone and website current.
